Get differential peaks for a pixel neighbourhood

Source: R/utils_processing_pixelenrichment.R
preprocessing_get_differential_peaks.Rd

For a given coordinate (x_tf, y_tf), compute differential peaks between the local neighbourhood and control samples using bulk_utils_DA.

Usage

preprocessing_get_differential_peaks(
  x_tf,
  y_tf,
  intensity.per.sample,
  metadata.per.sample,
  control.matrix,
  min.neighbours = 3,
  pvalue.cutoff = 0.05,
  lfc.cutoff = 0.5,
  test = "t-test",
  anno
)

Arguments

x_tf

Numeric; x_tf-coordinate of the target spot.

y_tf

Numeric; y_tf-coordinate of the target spot.

intensity.per.sample

Matrix or data frame of intensities (spots x features) for the sample.

metadata.per.sample

Data frame of spot metadata with x_tf, y_tf and spot_id columns.

control.matrix

Matrix of control sample intensities (features x control spots).

min.neighbours

Integer; minimum number of neighbouring spots required (default 3).

pvalue.cutoff

Numeric; adjusted p-value cutoff for significance.

lfc.cutoff

Numeric; log-fold-change cutoff for calling significance.

test

Character; statistical test to use (default 't-test').

anno

Data frame; annotation data for features used by bulk_utils_DA.

Value

Data frame of significantly differential peaks (or NULL if neighbourhood too small).
